start: Enquiries screen, an enquiry that is not yet a member

steps.action: Tap "Add as member" on the enquiry row
user_sees: Sheet titled "Add member"
Full name and Mobile number already filled from the enquiry, with the right country code
Joining date today
must_not: An empty form the desk has to retype
A number with the country code doubled
The enquiry marked joined before the member is saved

user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
The sheet closes and the enquiry is marked joined, linked to the new member (next screen is the member's page, or the thank-you sheet for a referred friend)
must_not: The enquiry left open after the member was saved
Two members for one enquiry

start: Today screen, "Joined online" card with a "Become a member" request

user_sees: Sheet titled "Add member" with name, mobile number and the gender the person chose already filled in
must_not: Gender left on "Not stated" when the person gave one
A different person's details

user_sees: The member is saved and the flow goes on to Sell membership on the plan and day the person picked (words of that sheet not read: unknown)
must_not: The flow closing before the plan can be sold
The request still listed as waiting

start: Members screen, "Joined in the app" tab, an app member who is not in the member list

steps.action: Tap the app member's card (spoken label "{name} is not in your member list. Add them")
user_sees: The Members screen at /members/new with the sheet "Add member" open, name and mobile number filled from the app
must_not: An empty form
A 10-digit app number given a country code other than +91

user_sees: The sheet closes and the new member's page opens
must_not: The prefilled values showing again on the next plain "+ Add member"

start: Enquiries screen, an enquiry whose number already belongs to a member

user_sees: Instead of the form, a sheet saying "{name} is already a member with {mobile number}."
Buttons "Cancel" and "Mark joined and open"
must_not: The Add member form opening for a number already in use
A second member with the same number

user_sees: The sheet closes; the enquiry is unchanged
must_not: The enquiry marked joined

start: Add member sheet opened from an enquiry, values filled in

user_sees: The sheet closes; the enquiry is still not joined
must_not: A member saved
The enquiry's own name changed

steps.action: Tap "Add as member" on the same enquiry again
user_sees: The form filled with the enquiry's own name and number again
must_not: The changed name kept from the cancelled try

start: Today screen, a "Become a member" request made on the gym's public page

steps.action: Tap "Make member" and look at the filled form before saving
user_sees: Only what the person typed on the public page: name, mobile number, gender
must_not: Details of another person or another gym's request
The request's details shown to anyone outside this gym's logins
A message sent to the person by opening the form
